name: zxm-toolkit-admin
description: 个人工具集合管理平台，基于 Monorepo 架构的全栈应用

scripts.build: yarn workspace admin build && yarn workspace client build && yarn server:build
scripts.server:build: cd apps/server && mkdir -p dist && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o dist/server-linux-amd64 ./cmd/server && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o dist/server-windows-amd64.exe ./cmd/server && cd dist && zip server-linux-amd64.zip server-linux-amd64 && zip server-windows-amd64.zip server-windows-amd64.exe && cd ..
